Truth boundary:
- This static site's availability does not establish A11oy product-runtime readiness.
- A link or HTTP response does not prove capability, safety, quality, or uptime.
- Public Hugging Face metadata is not an authenticated private inventory.
- Preserve MEASURED, REPORTED, MODELED, HEURISTIC, UNKNOWN, and UNAVAILABLE labels.
- Product runtime and receipt-verifier state must be observed at their own live sources.
- The /chat/ and /code/ pages are static Diligence handoffs, not product-runtime execution surfaces.
- There is no /investor route. There is no local /verify clone.
- RECORD on this origin is an index of pointers, not a receipt database. This repository has no receipt store. Live receipts stay on the product Space (Khipu + /data SZLHOLDINGS/szl-evidence + /api/lake/v1/receipts on a-11-oy.com). Interactive /verify is not cloned here.
- CNAME is a11oy.net. Live DNS is GitHub Pages. Product code may 301 a11oy.net to a-11-oy.com only if that Host is routed into the product app. This origin is not a product host.
- Canonical, og:url, and sameAs for these pages are https://a11oy.net/... never a11oy.com, never a Hugging Face Space as page canonical.
- _headers is policy intent. GitHub Pages does not apply it. live_edge_security_headers_deployment_proven=false.
